We’re delighted to announce our collaboration with Mr Moody’s Tavern on Saturday, 21 November!
description:
We’re delighted to announce our collaboration with Mr Moody’s Tavern on Saturday, 21 November!

Come and join us for a Boozy afternoon Tea, food by us and cocktails and atmosphere created by Moody’s and the lovely Rachel at Velvet Funk who will be DJing live for you. 

Molly has created an amazing cocktail menu, which you can check out on the second slide. 

This is a ticketed event priced at just £42 for two people sharing. 

The price includes:

- A beautiful afternoon tea platter based on two sharing!

- A complimentary glass of Prosecco on arrival!

- A goodie bag for each of you by Liberty Natural Skincare!

To book contact midweek@moodys on instagram or call Molly on 07902927183. 

Can’t wait to see you there 💚

THANK YOU to everyone, who joined us, for The Confessional Hull last night, and our amazing hosts, Phill and Rebecca 🥰
description:
THANK YOU to everyone, who joined us, for The Confessional Hull last night, and our amazing hosts, Phill and Rebecca 🥰

Although, I wasn’t personally there this time myself, (gutted to miss it) I hear, it was an evening, of laughter and tears, and exceptional, as always 

The Confessional, is on the second Wednesday, of every month, so get it in your diaries, for the 11th of November, if you would like to see what it’s all about

We look forward to seeing you! 

Lovely Sue
